none: PAS HAMP-E5A6F3: Roman coin: Radiate of Carausius (possibly irregular)
contea di ritrovamento: Hampshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A worn and corroded, possibly irregular later 3rd-century copper-alloy Roman radiate of Carausius (AD 286-93) (Reece Period 14), possibly 'MARS VICTOR' or similar, probably Unattributed mint. uncertain mint.
